name: Deadline and Cancellation Semantics
description: Tasks have deadlines. Cancellation is cooperative with timeout escalation to forced termination.
purpose: Prevent runaway tasks and ensure bounded execution time by defining clear deadline and cancellation contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks carry a deadline that specifies the latest allowed completion time
Cancellation begins with a cooperative signal to the agent
If cooperative cancellation does not complete within a grace period, forced termination escalates
Task cancellation cleans up resources and records cancellation reason
Deadline and cancellation state is observable and auditable
